references.text: Basic instructions for burnt offerings from cattle or sheep, the same categories of sacrificial animals mentioned in Num 15:3
The burnt offering is described as 'a pleasing aroma to the Lord' (ריח ניחח ליהוה), the same expression used in Num 15:3
Regulations concerning peace offerings (זבח) from cattle, one of the sacrifice types mentioned in Num 15:3
Refers to vow offerings (נדר) and freewill offerings (נדבה), the same categories mentioned in Num 15:3
Detailed rules for vow offerings and freewill offerings from cattle and sheep, parallel to the sacrifice types in Num 15:3
Introduction to the Lord's appointed feasts (מועדים), the same term as 'their feasts' in Num 15:3
Burnt offering as a fire offering for a pleasing aroma to the Lord (אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה), the same terminology as in Num 15:3
Summary of festival offerings including vows and freewill offerings, corresponding with the sacrifice categories in Num 15:3
List of sacrifice types including burnt offerings, slaughter offerings, vows, and freewill offerings - the same categories as in Num 15:3
First occurrence of the expression 'pleasing aroma' (ריח הניחח) in connection with an offering to the Lord
